observations.body: The signed-out root page displays the BugBusters HR employee portal sign-in form with Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and a Demo accounts section listing emily.dawson as Employee.
The Employee username and configured password have been entered and Sign in is ready to submit.
Sign in authenticated the Employee and displayed the dashboard shell with navigation and an Emily Dawson header.

The Employee dashboard welcomes Emily and offers navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, plus quick links Request leave and Fill timesheet; Notifications and Log out are also available.
My leave shows an available balance of 18 days, a New request link, and request history containing an approved Vacation entry dated Aug 18–19, 2026 with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel buttons; and states that weekends are not counted toward leave.
Timesheet displays a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
The empty Monday entry is set to 8 hours as evaluation data; the displayed total is 8 h and Save draft is ready to submit.
Save draft preserved the evaluation-data Monday value of 8 and displayed “Draft saved.” beside total 8 h.
The saved 8-hour evaluation-data week remains in draft state and Submit week is ready.
Submit week changed the marked evaluation-data week to submitted, displayed “Timesheet submitted.”, and disabled all hour inputs plus Save draft and Submit week.
My profile shows editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, an Upload photo action, and Save changes; the Email field is disabled and labeled read-only.

Employee directory loaded 28 employees with search-by-name, an All departments filter (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR), name sorting, and pagination showing page 1 of 3; Previous is disabled and Next is offered.
Searching the directory for Emily returned 1 employee, Emily Dawson in Engineering as Software Engineer, and changed pagination to page 1 of 1 with Next disabled.
